lines: Self-taught developer with a strong focus on <<Web UI/UX Engineer>> work, particularly in {{Web Frontend}} development.
Within ((Core Web)), [[HTML]] and [[CSS]] are a genuine strength — pixel-perfect attention to detail evident throughout.
[[JavaScript]] fundamentals are solid, likely strengthened through hands-on project work rather than formal study.
Clearly passionate about [[React]] — multiple personal projects demonstrate confident, production-quality usage.
Has explored {{Design}} seriously. [[Figma]] usage goes beyond developer handoff into real UI/UX thinking.
[[Sketch]] appears occasionally but [[Figma]] is clearly the preferred tool.
Backend exposure is minimal. Some [[JavaScript]] server-side usage spotted but no dedicated {{Core Backend Systems}} work.
[[REST]] APIs have been consumed as a client but never designed or implemented.
